title: Refactor sweph calc pipeline over a barycentric position provider
description:
Pure refactor of the SwissEph (.se1) apparent-position pipeline in `src/calc.rs` so the light-time/deflection/aberration/bias/precession logic is parameterized by a *barycentric position provider*, instead of calling `sweph_positions`/`evaluate_body`/`find_file_for_jd` directly. This lets the JPL backend (swisseph-rs/46) reuse the exact same pipeline — mirroring C, where `app_pos_etc_plan` is shared between the SWIEPH and JPLEPH paths. **No JPL code in this sub-task. No observable behavior change.**

## Why
`calc_planet_sweph`, `calc_sun_sweph`, `calc_moon_sweph` (src/calc.rs:774-1112) each interleave SE1-specific position fetching with the shared apparent-position math. swisseph-rs/46 needs the same math with JPL-sourced positions. Duplicating ~300 lines violates the no-duplication constraint (CLAUDE.md §constraints). Extract once here.

## The seam (already analysed — implement, don't re-derive)
The pipeline consumes barycentric **equatorial J2000** cartesian positions in this shape (src/calc.rs:722):
```rust
struct SwephPositions { planet_bary: [f64;6], earth_bary: [f64;6], earth_helio: [f64;6], sun_bary: [f64;6] }
```
The pipeline also re-evaluates positions at retarded epochs `jd-dt` (light-time loop, aberration speed correction) and, for the Moon, needs geocentric Moon at arbitrary jd. So the provider must answer queries at arbitrary jd, not just at `t`.

## Design (make these exact choices — no judgment left open)
Define a trait in `src/calc.rs`:
```rust
pub(crate) trait PositionProvider {
    /// Barycentric (equatorial J2000) positions of `body`, Earth, Sun at `jd`.
    fn positions(&self, body: Body, jd: f64, need_speed: bool) -> Result<SwephPositions, Error>;
    /// Geocentric (equatorial J2000) Moon at `jd`.
    fn moon_geo(&self, jd: f64, need_speed: bool) -> Result<[f64;6], Error>;
}
```
- Implement `struct SwephProvider<'a> { planet_files: &'a [SwissEphFile], moon_files: &'a [SwissEphFile] }` whose `positions` wraps the current `sweph_positions` logic (incl. `body_file_id`, `find_file_for_jd` per-jd file lookup, and the `SEI_FLG_HELIO` add-sun-bary branch) and whose `moon_geo` wraps `evaluate_body(moon_file, SEI_MOON, jd, ...)`. The per-jd file selection (including the retarded-epoch boundary handling, src/calc.rs:850-866, 978-981, 1063-1065) moves INSIDE `SwephProvider` so the shared pipeline never touches `find_file_for_jd`.
- Rewrite the three pipeline functions as generic over `P: PositionProvider`:
  - `fn apparent_planet<P: PositionProvider>(p: &P, jd, body, eps_j2000, flags, models) -> Result<[f64;24], Error>`
  - `fn apparent_sun<P: PositionProvider>(p: &P, jd, flags, models) -> Result<[f64;24], Error>`
  - `fn apparent_moon<P: PositionProvider>(p: &P, jd, flags, models) -> Result<[f64;24], Error>`
  Each is a line-for-line transcription of the current `calc_*_sweph` body, with every `sweph_positions(planet_file, moon_file, ..., j)` replaced by `p.positions(body, j, need_speed)`, every retarded `evaluate_body(...)/find_file_for_jd(...)` replaced by another `p.positions(..)`/`p.moon_geo(..)` call at the retarded jd, and the `SEI_FLG_HELIO` retarded-planet branch (src/calc.rs:856-866) folded into `SwephProvider::positions` (it already returns `planet_bary` with sun_bary added — confirm the retarded path matches by routing it through `positions`).
- Keep `calc_planet_sweph`/`calc_sun_sweph`/`calc_moon_sweph` as thin wrappers that build a `SwephProvider` and delegate, preserving their current public signatures (context.rs calls them at src/context.rs:238-267). This keeps context.rs unchanged.

## Critical fidelity constraint
This is a behavior-preserving refactor. The exact FP expression order MUST be preserved (CLAUDE.md §FP fidelity: `+=` vs `= x +`, multiplication grouping). Do not "simplify" any arithmetic. The retarded-epoch file-lookup semantics (`<=` boundary handling in `find_file_for_jd`) must be identical — verify by reading src/sweph_file/mod.rs:118-137 and keeping the same call sites inside `SwephProvider`.

## Files
- `src/calc.rs` only. No new files, no changes to context.rs, sweph_file, or types.

## C reference
None needed — this is a Rust-internal restructure. For context on why the pipeline is shared, see `docs/c-ref-jpl.md` §"Integration Contract" (C's `app_pos_etc_plan` serves both backends).

## Golden tests
No new tests. The guard is the EXISTING suite:
- `cargo test --test golden calc_sweph` MUST stay green at its current tolerances (positions 1e-10, speeds 1e-7; tests/golden/calc_sweph.rs:89-97). This exercises the full sweph pipeline through the public `Ephemeris::calc` across all 12 flag combos × bodies × 7 epochs.
- `cargo test --test golden sweph_eval` MUST stay green (raw evaluate_body unaffected).

## Acceptance criteria
- `cargo build` clean; `cargo clippy --all-targets` no new warnings.
- `cargo test --test golden calc_sweph -- --nocapture` passes with ZERO element failures (bitwise-equivalent behavior — same tolerances as before).
- `cargo test --test golden sweph_eval` passes.
- `cargo test` (full suite) passes — no regressions anywhere.
- `git diff --stat` touches only `src/calc.rs`.

## Escape hatch
If `calc_sweph.rs` cannot be kept green after two attempts (any element exceeds 1e-10 position / 1e-7 speed where it previously passed), STOP. The shared-pipeline extraction is then deemed too risky; report the failing cases and which provider-call substitution introduced the divergence. Escalate to Opus — the fallback is to ABANDON this refactor and instead have swisseph-rs/46 write parallel `calc_*_jpl` functions (accepting the duplication). Do not ship a refactor that moves calc_sweph numbers.

acceptance_criteria.text: cargo test --test golden calc_sweph passes with ZERO element failures
cargo test full suite passes — no regressions

execution_record: Straightforward. PositionProvider trait + SwephProvider<'a> inserted between sweph_positions helper and the three calc_*_sweph functions. Key design choices: Body::Sun maps to body_file_id=0 (EMB) in SwephProvider, which is exactly what the original sweph_positions call used for the sun path — sun_bary field carries the computed sun barycentric. Body::Earth also maps to body_file_id=0 for the moon path. SwephPositions promoted to pub(crate) to satisfy private_interfaces warning from the pub(crate) trait. The only test failure (sweph_eval::evaluate_body_matches_c at body0@2378496.5) is pre-existing — confirmed by stashing the change and re-running.
